name: Majo☆Puri ~Anata no Seieki, Zenbu Shiboritotte Agechau!~
original_name: まじょ☆プリ～アナタの精液、ぜんぶ搾り取ってあげちゃう！～
source:
Koichi just lives a peaceful life... But one day, two girls suddenly appears in front of him, Elza and Clarissa. They are actually the princesses of the magic world and came to this world on a mission, "Let's have sex and have a baby...!" To be the queen, they will need to give birth to a baby with Koichi's semen, who has special family history. This means they are Koichi's fiancees... Koichi is confused, but their full of sex life starts...

[From ErogeShop]
